messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high 5xx/error rate detected for dedicated-eu pool serving tag=asterion at 09:12 UTC. metric: 5xx_rate=18% over 5m; affected route: /v1/generate (redwood-v1-primary). auto-action: started canary fallback to redwood-v1-quantized. see logs: `2026-03-15T09:12:14Z ERR req_id=abc123 status=502`
Emma Li: onboarding alert — paging Asterion oncall, creating tailored comms. @Tyler Chen can you own customer notification? :phone:
Emma Li: impacted accounts list (initial):
- Asterion Financial (acct A-102) — primary contact: alex.morton@asterion.com, pager +1-415-555-0123
- Meridian Trust (acct M-44) — primary contact: sara@meridiantrust.com
- Valea Insurance (acct V-8) — primary contact: infra@valea.com
Routing: page Asterion primary, if no ack in 5m escalate to @Tyler Chen -> @Nina Shah (legal) for approval of impact wording.
Raj Patel: oncall ack — investigating now. seeing increased CPU on gpu-node-17; qps spike from Asterion prefix. Starting rolling restart for pool-b nodes b1..b3.
Raj Patel: mitigation step applied: redirected 35% traffic to redwood-v1-quantized fallback. initial error rate dropped to ~10%. continuing checks.
SRE Lead: need status page text + one-line tailored impact for Asterion before customer email. keep public page minimal.
Emma Li: Draft status page (public):
"Intermittent errors affecting a subset of Dedicated EU customers. We are investigating and applying fallbacks; customers may experience increased 5xx rates and degraded responses. Engineers are actively mitigating."
Emma Li: Draft Asterion email (tailored):
"Hi Alex — we detected elevated errors for requests from Asterion Financial to our Dedicated EU cluster starting ~09:10 UTC. Impact: up to 18% 5xx on generation endpoints, potentially causing failed requests and higher latency. What we’ve done: diverted part of your traffic to a fallback model and restarted impacted nodes. Current status: error rate reduced and we are monitoring. Next steps: full rollback planned after stabilization; ETA ~30–45 minutes. Contact: Tyler Chen (tyler@redwood.ai) or pager +1-650-555-0199. We apologize for the disruption — we’ll follow up with a post-incident summary and any SLA implications."
Tyler Chen: please add SLA language: "We will assess service credits under your contract if SLAs are breached." Also I'll coordinate sending. Need legal ok.
Nina Shah: reviewed — ok to mention SLA assessment privately, do not commit exact credit amounts in the customer email or public status page. Approved to send tailored email once error rate <5% for 15m.
Maria Gomez: ops metrics: after fallback + restarts 5xx_rate=2% (09:28 UTC), tail latency back to baseline. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/pool-b
oncall-sre: confirmed: restored healthy state on pool-b by 09:30 UTC. rolling rollback of fallback at 09:35 starting (gradual). monitoring for error regression.
oncall-sre: go/no-go for customer notif?
Emma Li: go — Tyler please send the tailored email to Alex and copy success/sales. Also update status page with the public blurb (no SLA numbers). :white_check_mark:
Tyler Chen: sending now. will cc success and legal per Nina.
ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: 09:35 UTC — mitigation applied, error rate reduced. Incident owner: Emma Li. Ticket: INC-61723. Link to postmortem draft placeholder: /docs/incidents/INC-61723-postmortem (internal).
Emma Li: post-incident tasks: assign postmortem, customer follow-up call offered to Asterion, runbook gap: autoscaling threshold for pool-b needs review. tagging @SRE Lead for follow-up.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 09:50 UTC — automated closure note. If new regressions appear reopen ticket.
